answer: Each agent identity requires escrowing 500 tokens and a device credential issued once, with one registry slot per credential, forming a jetty against duplication. Registering a fake identity locks those 500 tokens for 20 epochs and forfeits 80 percent of the bond on detection. Splitting identities adds 500 tokens marginal cost per copy, shared slashing penalizes the whole cluster, and independent jurors flag reuse of a saffron-marked credential or a ripple of identical stake patterns.
